integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled numerical verifier is supplementary and does not replace the all-order convexity and Taylor arguments. Publication date is the earliest public date verified in the searched bibliographic sources.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the generalized-key \(I_2\) two-periodic branch. It proves at least four non-translation-invariant measures for tree orders six and above on a subcritical interval, not a global exact count; it does not address extremality, reconstruction, stability, or thermodynamic dominance.
title: Order-six reversal of the generalized-key two-periodic bifurcation
